title: Why Odd Plus Odd Is Always Even
description: Pairing up dots to see why two odd numbers always sum to an even one.
narration_lines: Why does an odd number plus an odd number always make an even number?
Take 7 and 9 -- both odd, so each has one dot left over after pairing up.
Those two leftover dots pair up with each other.
No dot left alone, so 7 plus 9 is even -- every time.
